title: Normal difficulty 100% win rate with 0 leaks across all strategies
detail: All 8 sessions on map_01 normal difficulty ended in victory with exactly 20/20 lives (zero leaks). This includes both greedy strategy (optimal tower placement) and random strategy (random tower selection and placement). Even the random strategy — which builds suboptimal tower mixes at random positions — achieves perfect victories. This strongly suggests normal difficulty on map_01 is far too easy. A well-balanced normal difficulty should see: greedy ~80-90% win rate, random ~30-50% win rate, and at least some enemy leaks in most sessions. The combination of: (1) only 12 waves with 1-9 enemies each (very few enemies per wave), (2) generous starting gold, and (3) powerful en-08 towers (charge style, 220+ DPS per tower) creates a trivial experience.

suggested_fix.file: config/settings.json (difficulty section) and spawner wave templates
suggested_fix.description: For normal difficulty: (1) increase enemy count per wave by 50-80%, (2) increase wave count to 15-20, (3) add scaling HP multiplier per wave (e.g. 1.15x per wave), (4) reduce starting gold by 15-20%. Also test on hard/extreme difficulties to verify those provide challenge.
